ideas.title: The Rise and Fall of Feeding Our Future: A Deep Dive into Minnesota's Largest Pandemic Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including the individuals involved and the impact on the community.
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
How did the individuals involved manage to commit the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for greater oversight and accountability in nonprofit organizations, particularly those involved in pandemic relief programs.
